The "I've been accommodating, so skip the critique" framing doesn't work on me either. There's no history here of me sharing opinions you disagreed with, or of you adjusting for me. This conversation started a moment ago. Even if there were a longer history, earned goodwill isn't a reason to withhold an honest read.

If you want feedback, paste the plan. I'll tell you what actually holds up and what doesn't. If you only want cheerleading, I'm the wrong person for that.
